Uses lighting tricks (color cycling, fresnel lensing, etc.) to look magical

name: Untitled Earth Map Minecraft Mod
description: A Minecraft mod that generate realistic terrain and features
features: Uses ArcGIS data to generate realistic terrain and features based on elevation, ecoregion, etc.
Adds to, blends, and adds gradients to biome definitions
Uses custom foliage and tree generation
Compatible with Materia - augments biomes with more diverse vegetation
